entities.summary: Henry Wyatt Anderson is an American former professional football player who was a nose tackle in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal, and was selected by the Indianapolis Colts in the third round of the 2015 NFL draft. He also played in the NFL with the New York Jets, New England Patriots, and Carolina Panthers.
